User Goal: Summarize the active onboarding document and add a first-session checklist
Given: Getting Started/Welcome to Kition.md is the active document and contains the seeded onboarding guide
When: The user asks: Summarize this page in five bullets and add a checklist for my first Kition session
Expected Business Result: The Agent returns a five-bullet summary and appends one readable checklist to the active Markdown document
Critical Checks: The request is bound to Getting Started/Welcome to Kition.md; the Agent reads the active file; exactly one document write targets the same path; the saved document remains valid Markdown; no table or unrelated file changes
Negative or Recovery Branch: If the prompt asks only for a summary, no document write is allowed; if writing fails, the original document stays intact and the failure is visible
Coverage Status: Covered (mocked agent stream): binding to the open guide, one reported write to that file only, summary-only writes nothing, a failed write is shown and the guide is unchanged

Onboarding Entry: Any template-created table, especially Receipt OCR Table.ktable
User Goal: Review table quality and propose a cleanup workflow without running it
Given: Receipt OCR Table is active and contains incomplete extracted fields and records awaiting review
When: The user asks: Review the active table, identify missing values, and propose a cleanup workflow without running it
Expected Business Result: The Agent explains data-quality findings and proposes trigger, conditions, and actions, but does not create, enable, test, or execute a workflow
Critical Checks: The active document and table IDs are passed correctly; the proposal references real field names; no workflow create, patch, enable, node-test, record-write, or document-write tool completes
Negative or Recovery Branch: If the Agent attempts an execution tool, the scenario fails; provider failure leaves the table and workflow list unchanged
Coverage Status: Covered (mocked agent stream): binding to the open table, real field names, no workflow write from the page, table not saved, provider failure shown; the agent has no workflow tool (catalog test)

User Goal: Generate a concise summary for one reading-list row on demand
Given: The selected row contains Title and URL and the AI Summary field has auto_update=false with the seeded 2-3 sentence prompt
When: The user explicitly runs AI Summary for one cell
Expected Business Result: Only that cell receives a non-empty 2-3 sentence summary based on the selected row; source fields and other rows remain unchanged
Critical Checks: One model request; correct row and field; no automatic generation before the click; result persists after reload; rerun replaces the target cell once rather than appending duplicate text
Negative or Recovery Branch: On provider timeout or cancellation, the previous cell value and all source fields remain unchanged and the cell is retryable
Coverage Status: Covered; fixed: the seeded AI Summary prompt now names the row (Title, URL), which it did not. No run before the click, one request for the asked row, persisted, rerun replaces, timeout keeps the value and can be retried

User Goal: Turn uploaded receipt files into structured reviewable data
Given: The user attaches a known receipt image or PDF and uses the onboarding extraction prompt
When: The user starts the receipt-processing scenario
Expected Business Result: The generated table contains source filename, vendor, address, category, transaction date, total, and tax fields with one traceable row per receipt
Critical Checks: The attachment is included once; progress reaches completion; extracted values map to the correct receipt; source files remain available; the completed table can be reopened after reload
Negative or Recovery Branch: A malformed receipt becomes a reviewable failed or incomplete row without blocking valid receipts; cancellation creates no hidden partial final table
Test Mode: Scenario E2E with deterministic model fixture
Coverage Status: Covered on the runtime with a deterministic model (Table kit headless program): one traceable row per receipt with the attachment once, values from the right receipt, an unreadable receipt stays a row to review, reopens from disk; a run cancelled part way removes the table file it made (a_cancelled_run_leaves_no_partial_table_behind)

User Goal: Generate channel copy and a product image from one concept row
Given: A product row contains Concept and Concept description; seeded AI fields have auto_update=false
When: The user explicitly runs one text field and one image field for the selected row
Expected Business Result: LinkedIn copy follows the configured length and tone; the image field stores the configured number of valid attachments generated from the same concept description
Critical Checks: Only requested cells run; text and image use appropriate model capabilities; attachments render after reload; other concept rows remain untouched; generated output is associated with the correct source row
Negative or Recovery Branch: Failure or cancellation preserves prior generated values and source fields; retry replaces or updates the requested cell without duplicating attachments
Test Mode: Mocked text and image AI-field E2E
Coverage Status: Covered; fixed: the seeded LinkedIn and Twitter copy prompts now name the concept and brief, which they did not. Only the asked cells run, text and image outputs, three pictures kept and replaced on rerun, a refused run keeps the value

User Goal: Normalize email domains and phone numbers deterministically
Given: A client record has a mixed-case email address and a formatted phone number
When: The user opens Workflows, selects the client as the sample row, and runs the contact cleanup action
Expected Business Result: Email Domain becomes lowercase and Normalized Phone contains digits only on the same record
Critical Checks: Name, Email, and Phone stay unchanged; no new record is created; the run result identifies the selected record; repeating the deterministic transform produces the same values
Negative or Recovery Branch: A row with a missing email or phone reports a clear skipped or validation result and does not erase an existing normalized value
Coverage Status: Covered: positive path, unchanged source fields, no new record, repeat run, and the missing-email skip

User Goal: Flag only high-value expenses for review
Given: Conference tickets has Amount 2400 and Status Draft; Team lunch has Amount 280; Cloud subscription has Amount 899
When: The user runs the workflow against each representative row
Expected Business Result: The 2400 expense becomes Needs review with Review Note: Automatically flagged because the amount is above 1000; the 280 and 899 expenses remain Draft
Critical Checks: The filter uses Amount > 1000; only the triggering record is updated; no duplicate record is created; unrelated fields and rows remain unchanged
Negative or Recovery Branch: A missing or non-numeric Amount is rejected or skipped visibly and must not be treated as high value
Coverage Status: Covered: 2400 flagged; 280 and 899 skipped by the filter; a missing Amount skipped as an empty required field

User Goal: Look up an SKU and write catalog data back to the order
Given: Order #1001 uses SKU KB-101 and Product Catalog contains Kition Keyboard with Unit Price 129 and Category Hardware
When: The user runs the lookup workflow for Order #1001
Expected Business Result: The same order receives Product Name Kition Keyboard, Unit Price 129, and Category Hardware
Critical Checks: Match uses SKU; values come from the matching catalog record; the catalog remains unchanged; no new order is created; only configured write-back fields change
Negative or Recovery Branch: An unknown or blank SKU produces a clear no-match or skipped result and does not copy data from another catalog row or erase existing order values
Coverage Status: Covered: positive path, an unknown SKU (no match, nothing copied or erased), and a blank SKU skipped

User Goal: Copy a complete content idea into the publishing queue
Given: Content Ideas contains Product launch announcement with Channel Blog, Priority High, and Status Drafting
When: The onboarding workflow runs for that source record
Expected Business Result: Publishing Queue receives exactly one row with Title Product launch announcement, Channel Blog, Priority High, Source Status Drafting, and Automation Note Added automatically by workflow
Critical Checks: Source row stays unchanged; target field bindings are complete; one workflow execution creates one target row; the workflow is bound to Content Ideas and Publishing Queue
Negative or Recovery Branch: A failed target write creates no partial queue row; a source row missing a required field is blocked or reported instead of creating misleading content
Coverage Status: Covered: one queue row per run, source unchanged, an incomplete idea skipped, a missing queue and a removed field write nothing

User Goal: Preview a bound lead notification safely before email setup
Given: The seeded lead record contains John Doe, john.doe@example.com, ABC Corp, Manager, contact reason, and notes; the workflow is disabled and has no connection
When: The user opens the workflow and runs the side-effect-free action preview
Expected Business Result: Preview recipient is sales@kition.ai; subject is New Lead Submission Notification; body contains the real seeded lead values in the expected labeled sections
Critical Checks: Every field-reference token is bound to the imported Leads table; workflow remains disabled; no SMTP send occurs; no connection is created automatically
Negative or Recovery Branch: A renamed or removed field is surfaced as unresolved rather than silently substituting a different field; preview failure leaves workflow configuration unchanged
Coverage Status: Covered: exact preview of the seeded lead, a removed field named as unresolved, configuration unchanged, workflow stays disabled
